rundown: Stars beat Kings 148-111 at Adventist Health Arena in Stockton, CA in front of 1,083. Stars led 68-58 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Stars won it 39-17.
Leading the way — Stars: Tamar Bates 32 pts; Jaelen House 10 ast; Mohamed Wague 11 reb. Kings: Tristen Newton 28 pts; Sean Pedulla 6 ast; Jonathan Mogbo 11 reb.
Where Stars won it: they shot 50% to 48%, shot 52% from three to 34% and won the boards 45-39.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 23, 9:57 PM ET. It had Stars 64% and Kings 36%, projecting Stars 114.6 – Kings 110.4 (225.1 total, Stars by 4.2).

Final: Stars 148 – Kings 111. Right winner: it had Stars at 64%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Stars came in with a 10% above average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (3-2, 116.6 scored and 112 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 11 and 11 games of evidence. Projected to score 114.6, they scored 148 (+33.4 points, 29% over); projected to allow 110.4, they allowed 111 (+0.6 points, 1% over).

Kings came in with a 9% above average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (2-4, 118 scored and 124.3 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 12 and 12 games of evidence. Projected to score 110.4, they scored 111 (+0.6 points, 1% over); projected to allow 114.6, they allowed 148 (+33.4 points, 29% over).

The bigger miss was Stars' scoring (+33.4 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 259 against 225.1 projected (+33.9), about the 98th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Stars by 37 against Stars by 4.2 projected, about the 1st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.171 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -34 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 110 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.019 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Stars attack ×1.026, defense ×0.996 (5 games); Kings attack ×1.006, defense ×1.040 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 32.8 points), no bet.
